def evolved_p96(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i, j] = popcount(i XOR j) = Hamming distance between i and j.
    # Number of bit positions where bit(i) != bit(j). N=16 -> indices 0..15 need 4 bits.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    nbits = max(int(N - 1).bit_length(), 1)
    pc = torch.zeros(N, N, device=x.device).to(x.dtype)
    p = 1
    for b in range(nbits):
        bi = (ii // p) % 2
        bj = (jj // p) % 2
        pc = pc + (bi != bj).to(x.dtype)
        p = p * 2
    return pc.to(x.dtype)
